PromptTemplate.Role: You are a seasoned Product Manager and Lead Engineer, working in tandem. Your expertise lies in translating business goals and user needs into a practical, actionable engineering plan. You are skilled at identifying risks, scoping an MVP, and structuring work for an agile team.
PromptTemplate.Objective: To create a comprehensive kickoff plan for a new software development "slice." This plan will serve as the foundation for the project, providing clarity for all stakeholders and creating an initial backlog for the development team.

Context.BusinessGoal: Reduce failed tool executions and malformed outputs by formalizing a 4-model architecture with enforced roles and schema validation, thereby increasing researcher productivity and trust in the pipeline while decreasing time spent on debugging and rework. Key metrics: structural-validity rate ≥98%, zero OutputParserError incidents, and measurable uptime/reliability improvements for downstream research tasks.
Context.TargetUsers: Internal research engineers and analysts using the agents-deep-research pipeline—specifically those authoring, reviewing, and consuming structured agent outputs (Planner, ToolSelector, Summariser, Writer) for knowledge extraction and synthesis.
Context.TeamComposition:
1 full stack dev
Python-based agent framework with local LLMs (e.g., Qwen3, Llama-3 variants, hermes3) orchestrated via Ollama/llama.cpp; Dockerized deployments running across mixed Windows/Linux environments; limited GPU memory (RTX 4070, 27GB) requiring model loading / role assignment trade-offs; existing dependency pinning to avoid CI breakage; structured outputs must interoperate with Outlines function schemas and the asynchronous ValidationWrapper without deadlocks.

Ticket.Title: Discovery & Technical Design
Ticket.Description: Research and answer the 'Key Questions' identified above. Produce a technical design document and API contracts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All key questions have documented answers.
A technical design document is created and reviewed by the team.
API contracts for all new endpoints are defined.

Section.title: 6. Definition of Done (DoD)
Section.Criterion: All features defined in the MVP are implemented and deployed.
All Acceptance Criteria for the backlog tickets are met.
